The source/current academic rule contains multiple genuinely different decision mechanisms: stress-conditioned, suffix-conditioned, following-consonant-conditioned, semantic, and lexical root families. Existing active root units own several exception families but not the whole system. One counted mega-parent would hide mastery granularity; counting every source paragraph would inflate it. A dedicated child-family normalization pass is required.
